name: krw-axes
title: Two ways to score a report
idea: Scoring the 4,683 reports of six sites by KRW's loss at λ and by postrank's risk at τ = λ/(1 + λ) orders them the same way: one is an increasing linear function of the other.
from: v1 view · v1 G-09 krw-bridge, the two-axes view
credit: After Kline, Rose and Walters (2024), Section II and slides 24–26 and 29–30.
caption: Six fictional sites from the postrank tutorial, score A only; their independent normal posteriors are specified for teaching and taken as given. Every one of the 4,683 reports is evaluated under both objectives. The separate 97-firm grid card was computed under KRW’s archived probabilities and is evaluated as a fixed report.
